roles.attachment_type.shift_lead_hint: Filled first, before any station - always from employees marked Shift Lead in Staff, never assigned to a station automatically. One shift lead covers the whole company that slot, not per line.
roles.attachment_type.flexible_hint: For day-specific, non-standard hours (e.g. a Production Lead) rather than a fixed Day/Afternoon/Night block. Generate Suggestion only copies last week's same-weekday hours as a draft you can edit - it never invents a new time range.
roles.delete_confirm: Permanently delete this work station or task? This cannot be undone.
roles.delete_failed: This work station or task could not be deleted.
roles.save_failed: This work station or task could not be saved.
roles.min_headcount_hint: Generate Suggestion tries to fill this many people for this station every shift it runs, and approval is blocked while any are missing (when "Requires coverage" is on).
roles.fairness_weight_hint: Multiplies this role's hours when counting toward an employee's fairness score - 1.0 means no extra weight. Raise it for a harder or less-liked role so taking it counts as more load.
roles.allows_second_person_hint: Lets this station host a genuinely redundant extra worker, used only to close a min-hours shortfall for someone who'd otherwise fall short - never for normal staffing.
